policy: One project: core essentials execute canonical qml_tricks implementations through QML Utility. Read each scope before composing methods.

companions.trigger: Gradients or measured features collapse as encoding scale grows
companions.obligation: Sweep scale on validation; the product-encoder bound does not cover an arbitrary composite classifier

companions.trigger: Global observable has little usable signal
companions.obligation: Confirm the replacement loss still solves the target; inspect input-dependent purity and causal-cone assumptions

companions.trigger: Useful gradients exist but parameter geometry is poorly conditioned
companions.obligation: Count metric acquisition and solve costs; regularize singular directions; QNG cannot manufacture a missing signal

companions.trigger: A deeper variational circuit has unusable initialization gradients
companions.obligation: Use actual inverse blocks with independent trainable copies; initialization evidence is not full training evidence

companions.trigger: Inputs have useful locality and hierarchical pooling structure
companions.obligation: Verify data loading, pooling and objective assumptions; do not transfer the proof to arbitrary images after compression

companions.trigger: Hierarchical correlations and restricted entanglement plausibly fit the task
companions.obligation: Include classical tensor-network simulation as a comparator

companions.trigger: Raw text/image features are too expensive or unstructured for direct circuit loading
companions.obligation: Train the encoder inside training data and compare an equally tuned classical head; engineering companion

companions.trigger: Small-instance simulation can supply a useful initial circuit
companions.obligation: Keep simulator training time and transfer mismatch visible; engineering companion

companions.trigger: A trainable Pauli-rotation circuit needs a correct gradient
companions.obligation: Shift individual gate occurrences and apply the classical chain rule to nonlinear losses

companions.trigger: Noisy, many-parameter objectives make coordinate gradients expensive
companions.obligation: Count shots per loss estimate and validate perturbation/gain schedules; two calls are not two shots

companions.trigger: Measurement variance consumes the physical budget
companions.obligation: Use pilot variances, include pilot cost and preserve assumptions about independence

companions.trigger: Many requested local observables share a measurement record
companions.obligation: Account for shadow norms, locality and confidence rather than assuming a fixed shot count certifies precision

companions.trigger: Quadratic training kernel acquisition exceeds budget
companions.obligation: Validate landmarks and conditioning; new examples still require quantum queries

companions.trigger: A frozen quantum teacher is useful but deployment must avoid QPU queries
companions.obligation: Distill the teacher's feature map offline, gate export on held-out fidelity and task error, and verify zero-query inference; public vendor workflow is not a peer-reviewed success claim

companions.trigger: Target is a distribution over bit strings rather than supervised labels
companions.obligation: Use generative evaluation and classical generative controls, not a classification score
